scenario_automation.S09: measurement built in; real network impairment must be external and shared by all middleware
scenario_automation.S11: result fields reserved; shared external fault orchestrator required
scenario_automation.S12: built_in for every received formal message

measurement_constraints: One-way latency is valid only for processes on the same host because perf_counter_ns is used.
UDPv4 mode explicitly disables built-in transports and Data Sharing to prevent SHM bypass.
Application code is Python; Fast DDS and the generated DDS type support remain native libraries.
Recovery/drain arrivals are excluded from latency and throughput, but retained for final loss and recovery metrics.
